notes.title: Early Access
notes.content: Greetings to all. I would like to inform you that an error occurred during the release, and the game was marked as fully released, whereas in reality, it is still in early access. It took several days for the Steam platform support team to revert the game back to early access. I apologize if this caused any confusion. The game is not a finished product, and I will continue to work on its development and add new content whenever possible.
